publishingCadence.x: 1 high-quality post every weekday; 1 optional weekend post when there is real building-in-public material.
publishingCadence.linkedin: 2 posts per week, only when the content has professional or long-form value.
publishingCadence.website: Only when permanent knowledge is created.

rules: High-performing assets may be reused after 60 days with a new narrative.
Screenshots may appear across multiple campaigns.
Copy should not be repeated verbatim.

may: Swap prepared assets within the same campaign.
Move scheduled posts within a seven-day window.

rules: Promotional weeks should be followed by educational or behind-the-scenes content.

fallbackRules: If no conversation meaningfully reinforces an active campaign, publish the originally scheduled evergreen post.
If no evergreen post exists, surface the highest-ranked evergreen asset from the active campaign.
approvalPolicy: Every scheduled recommendation must include campaign, narrative, selected asset, reason, supporting signals, and confidence.
